sources.title: Honasa Consumer shares fall after equity worth ₹643 crore changes hands in upsized block deal

synopsis: Shares of Honasa Consumer Ltd. fell up to 4% following an upsized block deal worth Rs 643.4 crore. A total of 1.4 crore shares, amounting to 4.4% of the outstanding equity, changed hands at an average price of Rs 450 per share. Sources previously reported that Peak XV Partners Investments VI, Sequoia Capital Global Growth Fund III - US/India Annex Fund, and Redwood Trust were set to sell shares through block deals. Official buyers and sellers were not yet known at the time of reporting. The sellers face a 45-day lock-in period for any further share sales.
